snippet.title: LightSup! - Remote Play Together Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
LightSup! Demo will be available for everyone to play during the Remote Play Together Fest on February 12th - 19th on Steam. Wishlist and try out the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266750/LightSup/ 

In this demo, you can play with up to three friends either locally or using the Steam Remote Play. You will need 1 keyboard with a mouse and up to 3 game controllers, or 4 controllers at the beginning of the game. 

Please note that upgrade progression is not available at this time. However, you can still play the core game with 5 characters fighting through the first boss.
